request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red hood and red robe become near-black charcoal cloth with a thin bright violet trim along the hood's edge and the torn hem; every pale blue flame and spark (on the skull staff, at his hand, his eyes) becomes bright glowing violet; his face becomes pallid light ash grey. Keep the pale ivory skull on the staff, the white beard, the staff, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
